name: taobao-agent-adapter
description: A Playwright-based Taobao adapter scaffold for agent-friendly navigation using persistent browser profiles, network inspection, and state detection.

scripts.smoke:doctor: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js doctor --json
scripts.smoke:public: npm run build && TAOBAO_HEADLESS=1 node dist/src/cli.js public-smoke
scripts.taobao:probe: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js probe-session
scripts.taobao:search: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js search
scripts.taobao:open-result: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js open-result
scripts.taobao:open-href: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js open-href
scripts.taobao:probe:attached: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js probe-session
scripts.taobao:search:attached: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js search
scripts.taobao:open-result:attached: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js open-result
scripts.taobao:open-href:attached: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js open-href
scripts.taobao:visual-open:attached: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js visual-open
scripts.taobao:visual-resume:attached: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js visual-resume
scripts.taobao:visual-close:attached: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js visual-close
scripts.taobao:download-images: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js download-images
scripts.taobao:download-images:attached: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js download-images
scripts.ultrasource:search: npm run build && node dist/src/xianyu/cli.js search
scripts.ultrasource:open-href: npm run build && node dist/src/xianyu/cli.js open-href
